t: 6.4–7.1 Mw Lisbon地震造成约3万人死亡.
te: The 6.4–7.1 Mw Lisbon earthquake kills about thirty thousand people.
dz: 6.4–7.1 Mw Lisbon地震造成约3万人死亡.

te: Pressed by a food embargo, the five Catholic cantons of Central Switzerland declare war on the Protestant canton of Zur…
dz: 在粮食禁运的压力下,中瑞士五个天主教县向苏黎世新教县宣战,开始了第二次卡佩尔战争.
de: Pressed by a food embargo, the five Catholic cantons of Central Switzerland declare war on the Protestant canton of Zurich, starting the Second War of Kappel.

t: 五个天主教县在卡佩尔战役中击败了苏黎世新教州.
te: The five Catholic cantons defeat the Protestant canton of Zurich in the battle of Kappel.
dz: 五个天主教县在卡佩尔战役中击败了苏黎世新教州.
de: The five Catholic cantons defeat the Protestant canton of Zurich in the battle of Kappel.

t: 阿达尔苏丹国夺取埃塞俄比亚南部.
te: The Adal Sultanate seizes southern Ethiopia.
dz: 阿比西尼亚-阿达尔战争:阿达尔苏丹国夺取埃塞俄比亚南部.
de: Abyssinian–Adal war: The Adal Sultanate seizes southern Ethiopia.
